tools.name: convert_pdf_to_word
tools.description: pdfpeek: Use when an agent must convert a PDF to Word (.docx) for editing. For the reverse use convert_office_to_pdf; for plain text use convert_document_to_markdown. Add output=url for a 24 h link. Returns a .docx made by LibreOffice with one positioned text box per line, not reflowable paragraphs.
